description: This file declares the SharedStorageImplementation class, which implements multiple interfaces related to shared storage management, including configuration, notification, cache, and limit controls. It defines internal classes, methods for setting/getting/deleting storage values, managing notifications, and event dispatching within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing shared storage interfaces, managing storage operations, notifications, and events within the plugin framework.

classes.description: Internal class implementing notification interface for store events, forwarding value changes to the parent class.

classes.name: SharedStorageImplementation::Job
classes.description: Dispatch job class for asynchronous event handling related to shared storage events.
